sections.title: Give a route
sections.content: Combine movement verbs, direction words, locations and simple commands to describe a short route.

sections.title: Route patterns
rows: El museo está a la derecha.
The museum is on the right.

items.spanish: Ve al centro y gira a la derecha.
items.english: Go to the centre and turn right.

items.spanish: La farmacia está a la izquierda.
items.english: The pharmacy is on the left.

sections.content: A useful route pattern is: command + place or direction, then another command or a location statement.
